segments.en: Alright, so one of the great words that we heard in today's dialogue was exotic.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们在今天的对话中听到的一个伟大的词之一是异国情调。

segments.zh: 你有这么多奇怪的动物和植物，一切都是那么陌生。

segments.en: Right, so in my mind, Tahiti is very exotic. It's full of jungle and there's also beaches and it's very unusual for someone who's from America because it's just so far away.
segments.zh: 对，所以在我看来，大溪地非常异国情调。 它到处都是丛林，还有海滩，对于来自美国的人来说，这很不寻常，因为它离我们很远。

segments.en: That's right, exotic.
segments.zh: 没错，异国情调。

segments.en: So, someone can also have an exotic personality because maybe they're a little bit strange or not strange but not so common, maybe unique.
segments.zh: 所以，有人也可以有异国情调的个性，因为他们可能有点奇怪或不奇怪，但不那么常见，也许是独一无二的。

segments.en: Yeah, although exotic is usually kind of a sexy thing when you're talking about people.
segments.zh: 是的，虽然当你谈论人时，异国情调通常是一种性感的东西。

segments.en: You know, she looks very exotic. That means she doesn't look like everybody else here.
segments.zh: 你知道，她看起来很异国情调。 这意味着她在这里看起来不像其他人。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But another adjective to describe someone's personality is somebody that's very energetic.
segments.zh: 但描述某人个性的另一个形容词是一个非常有活力的人。

segments.en: All right, so energetic sounds like the word energy.
segments.zh: 好吧，energetic 听起来就像 energy 这个词。

segments.en: That's because they're related.
segments.zh: 那是因为它们是相关的。

segments.en: So, someone who's energetic has lots of energy.
segments.zh: 所以，精力充沛的人精力充沛。

segments.en: He or she likes to do a lot of things and wants to always go places.
segments.zh: 他或她喜欢做很多事情，总想去各种地方。

segments.en: You know the energetic person at your office.
segments.zh: 你认识你办公室里精力充沛的人。

segments.en: They always drink coffee.
segments.zh: 他们总是喝咖啡。

segments.en: Maybe they make everyone else really tired just listening to them.
segments.zh: 也许光是听他们说话，就让其他人觉得很累。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually, a person that's energetic usually also loves to socialize.
segments.zh: 实际上，一个精力充沛的人通常也喜欢社交。

segments.en: That's right. So, loves to means they like to but they like it a lot, right?
segments.zh: 没错。 所以，“loves to”的意思是他们喜欢，但程度很深，对吧？

segments.en: But to socialize means to talk to other people or to go to parties or to meet new people.
segments.zh: 但社交意味着与其他人交谈或去聚会或结识新朋友。

segments.en: So if it's a verb, to socialize means to talk to people, to meet people, to greet people.
segments.zh: 所以如果它是一个动词，社交的意思是与人交谈，认识人，问候人。

segments.en: You love to have contact with other people.
segments.zh: 你喜欢与其他人联系。

segments.en: So yeah, you're right. Very, very common for people who are energetic.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，你是对的。 对于精力充沛的人来说，非常非常普遍。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And what about someone that's practical?
segments.zh: 那么实用的人呢？

segments.en: What is that like?
segments.zh: 那是什么样的？

segments.en: Someone who's practical does a lot of things.
segments.zh: 务实的人会做很多事情。

segments.en: Maybe someone who's practical always comes to their activities prepared.
segments.zh: 也许务实的人参加活动时总是准备充分。

segments.en: So in my car, I'm very practical.
segments.zh: 所以在我的车里，我很务实。

segments.en: I have extra water and a spare tire.
segments.zh: 我有多余的水和备用轮胎。

segments.en: But you can also say, I'm a very practical person.
segments.zh: 但你也可以说，我是一个非常实际的人。

segments.en: I like to do things that I can achieve as opposed to someone who always wants to do things that they can't really achieve.
segments.zh: 我喜欢做我可以实现的事情，而不是那些总是想做他们无法真正实现的事情的人。

segments.en: Okay. So a practical person is usually very realistic and very down to earth.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以一个实际的人通常非常现实，非常脚踏实地。

segments.en: Maybe someone that's practical, if they're going on a trip, they'll only take what's necessary, not more than they need.
segments.zh: 也许务实的人如果要旅行，只会带上必要的东西，不会带多余的东西。

segments.en: Yeah, exactly. Let me give you a good example. I like to go hiking and sometimes I see women who have not made very practical decisions about the shoes they wear.
segments.zh: 是的，没错。 让我给你一个很好的例子。 我喜欢去远足，有时我会看到那些对她们穿的鞋子没有做出非常实际决定的女性。

segments.en: So I like to wear hiking boots.
segments.zh: 所以我喜欢穿登山靴。

segments.en: These are very practical.
segments.zh: 这些非常实用。

segments.en: Wearing high heels on a mountain is not very practical.
segments.zh: 在山上穿高跟鞋不是很实用。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay. Very good.
segments.zh: 好的。 非常好。

segments.en: Now, we also mentioned that a Capricorn is serious minded and conventional in many ways.
segments.zh: 现在，我们还提到摩羯座在许多方面都是认真的和传统的。

segments.en: Someone who's serious minded maybe doesn't like to have fun and go out and do things that are silly. Someone who's serious minded is usually very practical, I think, and really has a goal, wants to achieve that goal. No time to be silly.
segments.zh: 一个认真的人可能不喜欢玩闹、出去做傻事。我认为认真的人通常都很务实，而且有明确的目标，想要实现它。没时间犯傻。

segments.en: No time to make jokes.
segments.zh: 没有时间开玩笑。

segments.en: So it doesn't necessarily mean that the person is boring, but they're just very, as you said, practical.
segments.zh: 所以这并不一定意味着这个人很无聊，只是他们非常，正如你所说，非常务实。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And what about that a Capricorn also likes to do things in conventional ways?
segments.zh: 那么摩羯座也喜欢以传统方式做事呢？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So conventional means doing something in a conventional way means that you're doing it in a traditional way.
segments.zh: 因此，传统方式意味着以传统方式做某事意味着您正在以传统方式做某事。

segments.en: So this is a thing we've always done.
segments.zh: 所以这是我们一直在做的事情。

segments.en: We've always done it in this way, and I'm going to continue to do it in this way.
segments.zh: 我们一直以这种方式做，我也会继续以这种方式做。

segments.en: So the opposite is unconventional.
segments.zh: 所以相反的是非常规的。

segments.en: That means doing things in new ways, doing things with your imagination.
segments.zh: 这意味着以新的方式做事，用你的想象力做事。

segments.en: And so something that's very conventional is something that has been established, and we're just going to continue doing it that way.
segments.zh: 因此，非常传统的东西是已经建立的，我们将继续这样做。

segments.en: So for example, someone that gets married in a church is the conventional way, but someone that gets married while skydiving is very unconventional.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，在教堂结婚的人是传统的方式，但在跳伞时结婚的人是非常非常规的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Unconventional.
segments.zh: 非常规。

segments.en: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So a lot of great vocab here.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多很棒的词汇。

segments.en: Why don't we listen to her dialogue one last time, and we'll be back to talk with you a little bit more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不再最后听一遍她的对话，稍后我们会回来再和你聊聊。

segments.en: Hey, Lydia, what are you reading?
segments.zh: 嘿，莉迪亚，你在读什么？

segments.en: I'm looking at my horoscope for this month.
segments.zh: 我在看我这个月的星座运势。

segments.en: My outlook is very positive.
segments.zh: 我的前景非常积极。

segments.en: It says that I should take a vacation to someplace exotic and that I will have a passionate summer fling.
segments.zh: 它说我应该去异国情调的地方度假，并且会有一段充满激情的夏日恋情。

segments.en: What are you talking about?
segments.zh: 你在说什么？

segments.en: Let me see that.
segments.zh: 让我看看。

segments.en: What are horoscopes?
segments.zh: 什么是星座运势？

segments.en: It's a prediction of your month based on your zodiac sign.
segments.zh: 这是根据您的星座对您的月份的预测。

segments.en: You have a different sign for the month and date you were born in.
segments.zh: 不同的出生月份和日期，对应不同的星座。

segments.en: I was born on April 15, so I'm an Aries.
segments.zh: 我出生于 4 月 15 日，所以我是白羊座。

segments.en: When were you born?
segments.zh: 你是什么时候出生的？

segments.en: January 5.
segments.zh: 1月5日。

segments.en: Let's see.
segments.zh: 我们来看看。

segments.en: You're a Capricorn.
segments.zh: 你是摩羯座。

segments.en: It says that you'll be feeling stress at work, but you could see new exciting developments in your love life.
segments.zh: 它说你会在工作中感到压力，但你可以在你的爱情生活中看到新的令人兴奋的发展。

segments.en: Looks like we'll both have interesting summers.
segments.zh: 看起来我们都会有有趣的夏天。

segments.en: That's bogus. I don't feel any stress at work, and my love life is practically non-existent.
segments.zh: 那是假的。 我在工作中没有任何压力，我的爱情生活几乎不存在。

segments.en: This zodiac stuff is all a bunch of nonsense.
segments.zh: 这些星座的说法，全是胡说八道。

segments.en: No it's not.
segments.zh: 不，不是。

segments.en: Your astrology sign can tell you a lot about your personality.
segments.zh: 你的星座可以告诉你很多关于你个性的信息。

segments.en: See, it says that an Aries is energetic and loves to socialize.
segments.zh: 看，它说白羊座精力充沛，喜欢社交。

segments.en: Well, you certainly match those criteria, but they're so broad they could apply to anyone.
segments.zh: 好吧，您当然符合这些标准，但它们非常广泛，可以适用于任何人。

segments.en: What does it say about me?
segments.zh: 它关于我是怎么说的？

segments.en: A Capricorn is serious-minded and practical.
segments.zh: 摩羯座认真严肃，做事务实。

segments.en: She likes to do things in conventional ways.
segments.zh: 她喜欢以传统的方式做事。

segments.en: That sounds just like you!
segments.zh: 听起来和你一样！

segments.en: Alright, so talk about the horoscopes.
segments.zh: 好吧，说说星座。

segments.en: Which sign are you?
segments.zh: 你是哪个星座？

segments.en: I'm a Leo, which is actually...
segments.zh: 我是狮子座，其实是...

segments.en: I don't believe in the horoscope, but I have to say, every time someone tells me about Leos, Leo the Lion, right?
segments.zh: 我不相信星座，但我不得不说，每次有人跟我讲狮子座，狮子座的狮子，对吧？

segments.en: I agree with most of their descriptions of my personality.
segments.zh: 我同意他们对我个性的大部分描述。

segments.en: So, outspoken, loves to socialize, very opinionated, which means I have an opinion and I don't like to listen to other people, loves to argue very loud.
segments.zh: 所以，直言不讳，喜欢社交，非常固执己见，这意味着我有意见，我不喜欢听别人的意见，喜欢大声争论。

segments.en: So these are all qualities that I think I have, and some of them are bad, some of them are good, but you know, that's the way it is.
segments.zh: 所以这些都是我认为我有的品质，其中一些是坏的，其中一些是好的，但你知道，就是这样。

segments.en: But you don't really believe in what magazines or newspapers say about your outlook?
segments.zh: 但你真的不相信杂志或报纸上说的你的运势吗？

segments.en: Nah, I don't...
segments.zh: 不，我不...

segments.en: yeah, the predictions are usually just basic guesses.
segments.zh: 是的，预测通常只是基本的猜测。

segments.en: But what about you?
segments.zh: 但是你呢？

segments.en: What's your sign?
segments.zh: 你的星座是什么？

segments.en: I am a Taurus, so I was born in May.
segments.zh: 我是金牛座，所以我出生在五月。

segments.en: A bull.
segments.zh: 一头公牛。

segments.en: A bull, yes.
segments.zh: 一头公牛，是的。

segments.en: So I'm very stubborn and very strong.
segments.zh: 所以我很固执，很强壮。

segments.en: I don't really know what all the characteristics about the Taurus are.
segments.zh: 我真的不知道金牛座的所有特征是什么。

segments.en: Opinionated?
segments.zh: 有主见吗？

segments.en: Opinionated, I know that it's stubborn.
segments.zh: 固执己见，我知道它很固执。

segments.en: Loves to argue?
segments.zh: 喜欢争论？

segments.en: Yeah, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: Doesn't like to be corrected?
segments.zh: 不喜欢被纠正？

segments.en: Are you describing Taurus or are you describing me?
segments.zh: 你是在描述金牛座还是在描述我？

segments.en: Both.
segments.zh: 两者都。

segments.en: All right, so it's actually very interesting. I think in many ways, sometimes the glove does fit and someone's zodiac sign describes them very well. But again, maybe like the dialogue says, they are very broad descriptions that basically any person can relate to.
segments.zh: 好吧，这其实非常有趣。 我认为在很多方面，有时“手套确实合手”，某个人的星座确实能很好地描述他。 但话说回来，也许就像对话所说的那样，它们是非常宽泛的描述，基本上任何人都能对上号。

segments.en: Absolutely. I think that that's one of the tricks to horoscopes or to predicting someone's future.
segments.zh: 绝对。 我认为这是星座或预测某人未来的技巧之一。

segments.en: You tell them enough very vague things that maybe some of them will fit and some of them won't.
segments.zh: 你告诉他们有足够多的非常模糊的东西，也许他们中的一些会适合，而其中一些不适合。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But I'm very curious to hear about you guys. What are your signs? What's your sign? That means what's your zodiac sign?
segments.zh: 但我很想知道你们的情况。 你们是什么星座？ 你是什么星座？ 意思就是，你是什么星座？

segments.en: That's right. That's actually also a very common date question people say, oh, what's your sign?
segments.zh: 没错。 这其实也是一个很常见的约会问题，人们会说，哦，你是什么星座？

segments.en: Or a pickup line.
segments.zh: 还是搭讪话术。

segments.en: Or a pickup line.
segments.zh: 还是搭讪话术。

segments.en: Hey baby, what's your sign?
segments.zh: 嘿宝贝，你的星座是什么？

segments.en: To see if you're compatible, right?
segments.zh: 看看你是否兼容，对吧？

segments.en: Right. So let us know.
segments.zh: 对。 所以让我们知道。

segments.en: We're not trying to pick you up.
segments.zh: 我们不是想搭讪你。

segments.en: We're just curious.
segments.zh: 我们只是好奇。

segments.en: You'll find a lot of the words for the zodiac in today's lesson on our website, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 在我们的网站 englishpod.com 上，您会在今天的课程中找到很多关于星座的词。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
